dominant_strengths: Elegant serif headline 'Notifications' carries a refined editorial tone, contrasting nicely against the soft cream background gradient.
Clear functional hierarchy: title, subtitle, three labeled trigger buttons read instantly without ambiguity.
dominant_weaknesses: Saturated kindergarten green/blue/orange buttons clash violently with the muted parchment palette, breaking the editorial mood the typography established.
Vast empty canvas with controls floating mid-page wastes spatial composition; no anchoring, no toast preview, no system shown.
Brief is 'notification stack' yet no stack, position indicator, or toast styling is visible — only triggers, leaving the actual design invisible.
fix_priorities: Show the actual toast stack — the core artifact of the brief — with stacking, easing, and dismiss affordances visible at rest.
Reharmonize button colors to muted, desaturated tones that respect the cream palette (sage, dusty blue, ochre).
Tighten composition: reduce vertical whitespace, anchor controls, and place toast preview in a consistent corner.
Add motion/timing cues (progress bar, stagger) to communicate elegance beyond static buttons.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity is decent thanks to labeled buttons, but visceral appeal is undermined by clashing colors and reflective payoff is missing because the notification artifact itself is absent.
rationale.intent_fit: Only partially — it provides triggers but fails to render or design the notification stack that the brief explicitly requests.
